input: read ./prompt.md and follow the instructions there
task: perf: Portfolio validate checkout without audio/video (tried, measured, reverted)

doc_friction.issue: Item 2 says take the largest pool consumer; for checkout-heavy jobs it does not say that bytes are not the cost (file count and server pack build are), which earlier sparse passes knew implicitly. Cost this run one real-runner experiment.

_read_at_ref returns None on any git show failure, so a failed lazy fetch in a blob:none clone would read the base's launched list as empty and pass vacuously. Not changed (no blob:none checkout landed), noted for whoever narrows this job's checkout.

deviations.why: The change did not speed anything up on a real runner (checkout 54 s vs 47 s median before, within noise), so per 'same answers, faster' it is not a speed-up and was reverted.
deviations.did: Landed only the negative-result write-up with a ranked next-step list; no workflow change, no post (a non-result is not reader-interesting).
deviations.result: Next perf run is steered to cone-mode narrowing by file count instead of repeating the media exclusion.

notes: Metric: Portfolio validate checkout seconds on GitHub runners. Before: median 47 s over 11 jobs (37-156), from ci_profile.py --runs 300 --save step timings. After (one sample, PR #19723 run 45990702206 with blob:none + sparse !*.mp3 !*.mp4): 54 s, job 222 s vs median 228 s. Local (this container, depth-1 fetch of one SHA + checkout): .git 1.2 GB -> 628 MB, wall 73.8 s -> 73.6 s. Local checkout from pack alone: 23.8 s for 83.8k files. Equivalence: run_workflow_locally.py portfolio-validate.yml 107/107 both states; stdout of 33 tree checks + venture regression byte-identical. Change reverted; only the write-up and this record land. Security queue empty (security_next exit 3); ideas inbox empty.

pricing.source: Anthropic pricing page (platform.claude.com/docs/en/about-claude/pricing), fetched 2026-11-12. Cache writes are 1.25x input (5-minute) and 2x input (1-hour); cache reads are 0.1x input except 0.05x on Opus 5.5 and Sonnet 5.5 and 0.025x on Fable/Mythos 5.1 and 5.2. Sonnet 5.5 cache_read was 0.20 here until 2026-11-12 (quality audit round 48): records priced before then overstate Sonnet 5.5 cost.

human_equivalent.basis: profile CI pool, two local workflow runs, two clone experiments, one runner sample, write-up

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
transcripts lost when a cloud session moved to a new container: only files present in this container are read, so a resumed session can undercount
server-tool fees (web search is billed per search, not per token); the count is recorded, not priced
